description: In-enclave library layer for TLS-in-TEE: the 7-entry SourceRegistry, the SourceTlsClient over an injectable transport seam, and the CredentialProvider (PoC impl + KMS sandbox skeleton). These are leaf classes with no inbound coupling, ported VERBATIM in behavior from coordinator/sources.py. Covers spec tasks 1, 2, 3. Independent of FEAT-003 (coordinator) and FEAT-004 (verifier); FEAT-002 depends on this feature.
steps: Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/SourceEntry.java as a record {String id, String provider, String host, int port, String method, String pathTemplate, java.util.Map<String,String> requiredParams, String authType, String expectedFormat}.

Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/SourceRegistry.java holding exactly 7 entries: getOrderMetrics(amazon,GET,/sales/v1/orderMetrics), listFinancialEventGroups(amazon,GET,/finances/v0/financialEventGroups), listTransactions(amazon,GET,/finances/2024-06-19/transactions), alicloudTelThree(alicloud,GET,/lundear/telThree), qichachaEnterpriseVerify(qichacha,GET,/EnterpriseInfo/Verify), qichachaShixinCheck(qichacha,GET,/ShixinCheck/GetList), gutuPanoramaChecks(gutu,POST,/api/v1/judicial/panorama-checks). Port host base-URL selection from sources.py resolve_base_url (precedence: per-provider env override var [AMAZON_SP_BASE_URL/ALICLOUD_BASE_URL/QICHACHA_BASE_URL/GUTU_BASE_URL] > mode default; mock default MOCK_BASE_URL_DEFAULT='http://localhost:4010' for PoC, SANDBOX_BASE_URLS per provider for sandbox). SOURCE_MODE env: anything other than 'sandbox' means mock. Add static qichachaToken(appKey,timespan,secretKey) returning lowercase-hex md5(appKey+timespan+secretKey). Expose resolve(sourceId) -> SourceEntry that throws new IllegalArgumentException("SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID") for unknown ids. All env reads go through an injectable Map<String,String> (default System.getenv()) so tests are offline.

Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/SourceTransport.java: an interface 'java.net.Socket connect(String host, int port) throws IOException' seam (mirrors coordinator VsockChannel/AfVsockTransport). Provide a default impl that opens a plain TCP Socket (production will swap a vsock->TCP transport; that binding is FEAT-002/EnclaveMain's job).

Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/SourceTlsClient.java: constructor takes a SourceTransport and a CA-bundle source (configurable path or classpath resource; load into a TrustManagerFactory). Method fetch(SourceEntry entry, Object requestBody, Map<String,String> authHeaders) -> byte[]: obtain a base Socket from the transport, wrap it in an SSLSocket via an SSLContext built from the loaded trust store, start the handshake, VALIDATE hostname against entry.host (throw new IllegalArgumentException("TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED") on any chain/hostname failure), then send an HTTP/1.1 request: request line from entry.method + entry.pathTemplate (+ encoded requiredParams for GET), headers Host, Connection: close, Accept-Encoding: identity, the authHeaders, and for POST Content-Type: application/json plus the JSON-serialized body with Content-Length. Read the FULL response bytes R (status line + headers + body until close) and return R. NEVER log request/response bytes or header values.

Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/CredentialProvider.java: interface headersFor(SourceEntry entry, java.util.Map<String,Object> requestContext) -> java.util.Map<String,String>.

Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/PocCredentialProvider.java implementing CredentialProvider: reads an injectable env map; returns {"x-api-key": <MOCK_API_KEY>} when that env var is non-empty, else {} (mock mode = zero provider secrets, mirroring sources.py _mock_api_key_headers + mock-mode build_auth_headers returning {}).

Create nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/KmsAttestedCredentialProvider.java: a documented SEAM/skeleton for sandbox/prod. headersFor builds the provider auth header per sources.py build_auth_headers (amazon x-amz-access-token incl. an LWA exchange hook; alicloud 'Authorization: APPCODE '+code; qichacha key/Timespan/Token via SourceRegistry.qichachaToken; gutu 'Authorization: Bearer '+token). It decrypts ciphertext via KMS gated on the attestation document (documented as a hook; may be a no-op stub that throws new IllegalArgumentException("SOURCE_AUTH_FAILED") when a required credential is absent). NEVER log secret values.
acceptance_criteria: SourceRegistryTest: all 7 ids resolve to the correct provider/host/method/path; an unknown id throws IllegalArgumentException with message 'SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID'; SourceRegistry.qichachaToken("appkey123","20240101120000","secret456") equals "a944de67cf3bfb9eca4c83db310fda07"; base-URL selection honors a per-provider env override and falls back to the mock default when SOURCE_MODE is not 'sandbox'.

SourceTlsClientTest: against a local in-process TLS stub (self-signed cert + custom trust store) the returned bytes equal the stub's full response; the HTTP/1.1 request line + Host/Connection: close/Accept-Encoding: identity headers are shaped correctly (asserted by the stub capturing the request); a hostname/chain mismatch throws IllegalArgumentException('TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED').

CredentialProviderTest: PocCredentialProvider returns {} with an empty env and {x-api-key:...} when MOCK_API_KEY is set; the sandbox header builder (fed a fake env map) produces the correct header NAME per provider (x-amz-access-token / Authorization / key+Timespan+Token); a missing required credential yields SOURCE_AUTH_FAILED.
No secret/token/raw-byte value is passed to any logger in any new class.
verification: cd nitro-enclave; mvn test  -> BUILD SUCCESS with SourceRegistryTest, SourceTlsClientTest, CredentialProviderTest all passing and the pre-existing EnclaveServiceTest still green (3 original + new).
findings:
DONE. Package com.olea.dowsure.enclave (nitro-enclave module). mvn test from nitro-enclave = BUILD SUCCESS, 19 tests (3 original EnclaveServiceTest + 16 new), 0 failures.

Classes created (all in src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave):
- SourceEntry: record SourceEntry(String id, String provider, String host, int port, String method, String pathTemplate, Map<String,String> requiredParams, String authType, String expectedFormat). authType currently == provider key; requiredParams is Map.of() (mock defaults empty; FEAT-002 can populate sandbox params per sources.py build_amazon_params if needed).
- SourceRegistry: `new SourceRegistry()` (System.getenv) or `new SourceRegistry(Map<String,String> env)`. Methods: `String mode()` (sandbox vs mock), `String resolveBaseUrl(String provider, String mode)`, `SourceEntry resolve(String sourceId)` (throws IllegalArgumentException("SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID") on unknown id), and static `String qichachaToken(String appKey, String timespan, String secretKey)` (lowercase-hex md5). resolve() derives host/port from the resolved base URL via URI (mock default http://localhost:4010 -> host=localhost port=4010; https sandbox -> port 443). 7 ids: getOrderMetrics, listFinancialEventGroups, listTransactions, alicloudTelThree, qichachaEnterpriseVerify, qichachaShixinCheck, gutuPanoramaChecks.
- SourceTransport: interface `java.net.Socket connect(String host, int port) throws IOException`. Nested default impl `SourceTransport.TcpSourceTransport` opens a plain TCP Socket. THIS IS THE SEAM FEAT-002/EnclaveMain swaps for a vsock->TCP transport.
- SourceTlsClient: ctor `SourceTlsClient(SourceTransport transport, String caBundlePath)` (PEM file path OR classpath resource) and `SourceTlsClient(SourceTransport transport, KeyStore trustStore)` (test ctor). Method `byte[] fetch(SourceEntry entry, Object requestBody, Map<String,String> authHeaders)`. Wraps the base socket in SSLSocket, sets endpoint-identification HTTPS (hostname validated against entry.host()), HTTP/1.1 request (Host, Connection: close, Accept-Encoding: identity, auth headers, POST adds Content-Type: application/json + Content-Length + JSON body), returns FULL response bytes until close. Any handshake/chain/hostname failure -> IllegalArgumentException("TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED"). Pure pass-through (no transform). Never logs bytes/headers.
- CredentialProvider: interface `Map<String,String> headersFor(SourceEntry entry, Map<String,Object> requestContext)`.
- PocCredentialProvider implements it: `new PocCredentialProvider(Map<String,String> env)` -> {} unless MOCK_API_KEY set, then {x-api-key: <val>}.
- KmsAttestedCredentialProvider implements it (sandbox/prod SEAM): amazon->x-amz-access-token (reads AMAZON_ACCESS_TOKEN as the attested-KMS/LWA hook output, optional x-amz-sigv4-region from AWS_REGION), alicloud->Authorization: APPCODE <ALICLOUD_APPCODE>, qichacha->key/Timespan/Token (timespan from requestContext['timespan'] or QICHACHA_TIMESPAN env; Token via SourceRegistry.qichachaToken), gutu->Authorization: Bearer <GUTU_TOKEN>. Missing required credential -> IllegalArgumentException("SOURCE_AUTH_FAILED"). KMS-attested decrypt itself is a documented hook (env map stands in for the decrypted material in this run; no live KMS/attestation here).

Error codes thrown as IllegalArgumentException(message): SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID, TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED, SOURCE_AUTH_FAILED.

Test resources added for SourceTlsClientTest: nitro-enclave/src/test/resources/test-server.p12 (self-signed CN=localhost, SAN dns:localhost+ip:127.0.0.1, PKCS12, pass 'changeit') and test-ca.pem (its exported cert). Tests use an in-process SSLServerSocket stub + a local plain-socket SourceTransport.

Note for FEAT-002 wiring: EnclaveMain should instantiate SourceRegistry(), choose PocCredentialProvider vs KmsAttestedCredentialProvider by SOURCE_MODE, and construct SourceTlsClient with a vsock->TCP SourceTransport + the production Amazon/public CA bundle (path or classpath resource).
